gloss: speed per second; meters per second

definitions.gloss: speed per second; meters per second
definitions.explanation: A unit of speed measuring the distance traveled per second. Often expressed as 秒速〜メートル (~ meters per second).

examples.japanese: {光|ひかり}は{秒速|びょうそく}{約|やく}30{万|まん}キロメートルだ。
examples.english: Light travels at approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{風速|ふうそく}は{秒速|びょうそく}50メートルに{達|たっ}した。
examples.english: The wind speed of the typhoon reached 50 meters per second.

examples.japanese: {音|おと}の{速|はや}さは{空気中|くうきちゅう}で{秒速|びょうそく}{約|やく}340メートルだ。
examples.english: The speed of sound in air is approximately 340 meters per second.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in scientific contexts and weather reports. Wind speed in Japan is typically expressed in 秒速 (meters per second), unlike some countries that use kilometers per hour.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秒速|びょうそく}〜メートル (~ meters per second)
- {秒速|びょうそく}〜キロメートル (~ kilometers per second)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時速|じそく}: speed per hour — kilometers per hour
- {分速|ふんそく}: speed per minute — meters per minute
- {風速|ふうそく}: wind speed — the speed of wind
